name: retro-picross-archaeologist
description: Retro Picross Archaeologist UI - Game Boy Edition web application, ready for Capacitor

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','puzzles.js','translations.js','manifest.json','icon.svg','icon-192.png','icon-512.png'].forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f); }); console.log('Built www successfully');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'tools/jdk-21.0.12.1+1'); cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; Copy-Item app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../Alien-Picross-debug.apk -Force; Write-Host 'APK generated at: Alien-Picross-debug.apk'"
